claims.text: Many reviewers report visible skin improvements, such as younger-looking, fuller, tighter, or glowier skin and reduced discoloration.
Several reviewers received a brown, dark orange, or otherwise discolored serum, sometimes with a strong chemical or unpleasant smell, and questioned whether it was oxidized or spoiled.
Reviewers praise the product's value, noting it is much cheaper than comparable department store products and worth the money.
Some reviewers say it is too early to judge long-term results on fine lines and wrinkles, though early impressions are positive.
Reviewers highlight the pleasant texture, noting it goes on with no stickiness and dries quickly.
